_doc: Looping road routes of vehicles that can be grabbed or driven by (CAP-14; the traffic epic reuses and extends this). `map`: the map id the route belongs to; `kind`: key into `targets` of data/grab.json; `count` vehicles are spread evenly along the loop; `speed` px/s; `points` tile coordinates (x.5/y.5 = tile centres, continuous values allowed) of a closed polyline. Main road of the town: the eastbound lane is y 57 (south), the westbound lane y 55, half-circles turn at both ends.
